newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel heads to meet French minister.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel heads to meet French minister.

text.p: The French and British co-chairmen of Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA /Plc plan to meet French Transport Minister Bernard Pons later this week, a ministry official said on Tuesday.

Co-chairmen Patrick Ponsolle and Robert Malpas on Monday met British deputy prime minister and head of the transport and environment ministry John Prescott, who wants a review of the design of the Shuttle freight wagons to improve safety.
British concerns over the wagon design are holding up resumption of the freight service, which is needed to gain shareholder and bank approvals for a debt restructuring.

Eurotunnel had planned to restart a limited freight service last Thursday, but the Inter Governmental Commission withheld safety approval due to a last-minute hardening of the British government's position on the wagon design.

The wagons' open-lattice design was been heavily criticised by the Kent Fire Brigade for the severity of a blaze which started on a lorry on November 18 and which badly damaged a section of the Tunnel.
